title: Semilinear damped wave equation on a compact Lie group with a non-autonomous forcing term
summary: In the present note, we consider a semilinear damped wave equation on a compact Lie group with a non-autonomous nonlinearity $\varphi(t)|u|^p$. We are interested in describing how the nonnegative time-dependent factor $\varphi$ affects the global in time prolongability of a local solution. In particular, the summability of the function $\varphi$ provides a criterion to distinguish between the blow-up in finite time and global existence of small data.
